mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is a warm 85 degrees with clear skies out at Reddan Soccer Park. The moon is in its third quarter phase, and if you look up tomorrow morning at 4:19 AM, you can catch the space station as it passes from near Verona High School toward Fitchburg, reaching about halfway up the sky. Tonight will be quiet with a low of 72 degrees and no rain in the forecast.

The city has officially unveiled the Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture at Century School Park, a beautiful project carved from a reclaimed ash tree by artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland. Additionally, the Senior Center is currently highlighting their diverse exercise programs including everything from drum-based cardio to Bollywood-inspired stretching to keep our residents active and engaged.

We have a busy schedule for the next couple of days in Verona. Today, you can catch the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, enjoy Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, or head to trivia at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, the fun continues with trivia over at Hop Haus Brewing Company.

In a noteworthy call from this past week, on August 25, Verona police officers successfully utilized an AED to assist a man in a medical emergency, highlighting the department's readiness to support emergency services at all times.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Oreo Reese's Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open, so be sure to stop by before they close at 10 PM tonight.
